scripts.start: build_id="start-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$"; python3 scripts/build-m1.py "$build_id" && python3 scripts/serve-candidate.py "$build_id" 4173
scripts.build:renderer: wasm-pack build renderer --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name boardstudio_renderer_wasm --release --locked
scripts.build:renderer:dev: wasm-pack build renderer --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name boardstudio_renderer_wasm --dev --locked
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:cad && pnpm run build:renderer:dev && cargo check --manifest-path web/Cargo.toml --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features page --bin boardstudio-web && pnpm --dir cad exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.precommit: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo test --manifest-path renderer/Cargo.toml --locked && pnpm run build:renderer:dev && pnpm --dir ergogen test && pnpm --dir kicad test && pnpm --dir cad test && cargo test --manifest-path web/Cargo.toml --locked --lib --bin boardstudio-web
scripts.check: pnpm run check:repo && pnpm run check:contracts && pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run test && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm --dir cad check && pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.dev:react: pnpm --dir ergogen prepare:catalog && pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:cad && pnpm run build:renderer:dev && pnpm --dir app dev
scripts.build:react: pnpm --dir ergogen prepare:catalog && pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:cad && pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm --dir app build
scripts.typecheck:react: pnpm run build:cad && pnpm run build:renderer:dev && pnpm --dir app exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --dir cad exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:browser: python3 scripts/check-wasm-tests.py && pnpm run test:browser:prepare && python3 scripts/run-wasm-tests.py --all
scripts.test:perf:react: pnpm run build:react && pnpm --dir app test:perf
